alex: Quick thread to coordinate on-call handoffs + new shadowing. Lia starts shadowing tomorrow (first week). Also spotted a coverage gap Friday 22:00-02:00 UTC unless we swap.

alex: TL;DR: need primary/secondary for Wed-Fri, point people for paging escalation, confirm runbook links, and schedule a 1-hr shadow pairing for Lia (live page walkthrough).

oncall-bot: [ALERT] Reminder: please ack rotations and update the rota dashboard: https://redwood.internal/rota (automated) :bell:

maya: I can be primary Wed/Thu daytime (13:00-21:00 UTC). Not ideal overnight.

kevin: I can take Thu night (21:00-02:00 UTC) if someone covers Thu daytime.

alex: Okay — propose: Wed primary = maya, Wed secondary = kevin. Thu primary = alex (I'll swap my usual shift), Thu secondary = kevin. Fri night open 22:00-02:00 UTC — Sara, can you stretch a few hours?

sara: I can do Fri 22:00-00:00 UTC, then jordan can take 00:00-02:00? @jordan?

jordan: Yup I can pick up 00:00-02:00 UTC on Fri.

alex: Great. I'll update rota dashboard after we confirm. Lia — you'll shadow with maya on Wed 14:00 UTC for the live pager walkthrough. Plan is 1 hour: 15 min orientation, 15 min dry-run, 30 min live walk through a resolved postmortem example. OK?

lia: Sounds good. Thanks! Would love a checklist to follow.

maya: I'll run through the checklist. Pasting minimal handoff/shadow checklist here:

```
Handoff / Shadow checklist:
- Confirm contacts: primary, secondary, infra lead, SRE pager list
- Walk through common pages: prod-latency, seq-store-errors, model-oom
- Demonstrate how to read the request traces in Console -> Traces
- Show runbooks: latency_runbook / model_oom_runbook
- Practice escalation: when to ping #eng-sre, when to page L3
- Debrief and log notes in incident tracker
```

maya: Runbooks (quick links):
- latency: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency
- model OOMs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model_oom
- paging/escalation: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging_escalation

alex: A few runbook highlights to emphasize during shadowing:
- If prod-latency alert fires, check: GC/queue depth, throughput on Dedicated pools, and recent model rollouts.
- If request rate is stable but tail latency spikes, try switching traffic to lower-capacity region (route fallback) before scaling.
- For suspected model regressions, run the quick-probe prompt set (link in model_oom runbook) to validate before rollback.

kevin: Small ops tip: Use this command in the debug container to tail the runtime logs filtered for request id (helps during pages):
```
sudo journalctl -u redwood-runtime -f | rg "request_id=YOUR_ID" --line-number
```

alex: Also reminding everyone: during high-severity incidents, use the incident channel template: start with impact statement, mitigation in progress, and next actions. Example: “sev2 - Customers A,B seeing 503s while Dedicated pool nears OOM; mitigation: redirect 10% traffic to fallback model, scaling requested.”

oncall-bot: Paging log: last 7 days — prod-latency x4, seq-store-errors x2, model-oom x1. See https://redwood.internal/paging/logs

maya: One more: Lia, we'll simulate a page at the start of the session. I'll trigger the non-prod latency alert so you can practice acknowleding, finding the trace, and drafting a quick impact blurb.

lia: Perfect. Also, any preference on how I should record notes?

alex: Please add shadow notes to the onboarding doc here: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/lia-shadow and append a short checklist with what you observed. We'll keep it internal and used for followup.

kevin: Confirming I'll be on primary Thu night handoff with alex taking day; alex will be primary Fri daytime.

alex: Yep. I'll post a final rota update in 10m and set calendar invites for the Wed 14:00 pairing with maya + lia.

sara: Quick flag — gap coverage for Fri mid-day (12:00-16:00 UTC) might be light because of PTO. I'll coordinate with product to delay noncritical deploys.

alex: Good catch. Please add a deploy freeze note for Fri 11:00-18:00 UTC in #deploys if not already posted.

jordan: minor note — if you need to escalate to infra/hypervisor team, ping me directly and DM on-call-bot with the incident id, then I'll open the brief channel on their side.

alex: Thanks all. I'll update the rota dashboard and post the confirmed primary/secondary table here in 10. We'll use this thread as the single source of truth for the handoffs and shadow schedule. If anyone needs to swap, comment here so I can update the dashboard. :thumbsup:

(oncall-bot auto-reaction): :white_check_mark:
